notes.title: Wild Life Update Announcement - October 20th

notes.title: Begin your settlement on July 21st with CrafTAE's release!
notes.notes: [p]Here we are, a few weeks away from launch. What an [b]awesome journey[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Are you prepared for [b]what's coming[/b]?[/p][p][/p][h2]🃏 9 dungeons 👿[/h2][hr][/hr][p]Fight [b]new enemies[/b] and unlock [b]new dungeons[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]Each dungeon should offer a unique challenge, with different loot and attributes, leading you to [b]new and exciting gameplay[/b]. Each dungeon will have[b] 3 difficulties[/b]: basic, advanced and expert.[/p][p][/p][p]Craft new strategies to face the expert difficulty, where each dungeon shall have a [b]unique trait[/b].[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471369/bb4f93d7ed4b07785184f38c494d0bb597f95589.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]🃏 10 biomes 🌳[/h2][hr][/hr][p]Unlock and explore new biomes! Find [b]new cards[/b] and craft [b]new equipment[/b] to help you reach higher difficulties! Iron ore, kisil crystal, magic essence, all [b]game changers[/b]! Fish, enchant, pray and smelt away![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45471369/9c8a5fbbafb682fc5859544b7286d14779be4bb1.jpg"][/img][/p][h2]🃏 313 cards to find 👁️[/h2][hr][/hr][p]Find all 313 cards to become an [b]omniscient[/b] [b]master[/b] of settlement![/p][p][/p][h2]∞ Endless mode and leaderboard 🏆[/h2][hr][/hr][p]Okay, this right here is the stuff.[/p][p][/p][p]Win a dungeon on advanced or expert difficulty to unlock the [b]endless mode[/b]! A [b]challenging nightmare[/b] mode that you shall endure as long as you can to stand out in the leaderboard![/p][p][/p][p]We can't wait for you to get your hands on the game and share your thoughts with us. See you on [b]July 21st[/b]![/p][p][/p][p]Cheers,[/p][p]mappe[/p]
